title: Hooks guard in-session krn-lane subagents by payload agent_type, not by environment
body:
Why: Fable audit 1114f (.krn/runs/overnight/fable-audit-1114f.md) fix 2: src/hook/scope.ts:91-92 and src/hook/stop.ts act only on KRN_SESSION_CLASS=lane / KRN_ROLE=worker; krn-lane subagents carry the lead env so KRN-11 scope and the Stop check enforce nothing on them.
Outcome: both hooks read agent_type/agent_id from the payload (as src/hook/lead-file-read.ts:160 does); SubagentStop wired.
Proof: captured payload with agent_type krn-lane writing tasks/x.json (not its own) exits 2 (KRN-12 verbatim capture).
